notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR13: "In level 2, there is no restriction on the value of the data item referenced by data-name-1." The compiler implements level 2 of the module: ReadClauses accepts DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS, nothing pins the count to 1, and the only run-time limit is ValidCount's 1 through integer-1 of §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR17. Probed: counts 3 and 2 of a 3-entry table (3 set by a first-redefinition VALUE) accepted and delivered to that many destinations; 4 and 9999 got 30; count 1 without a table accepted and 2 got 30. The witness sends to two destinations with count 2.

next.reason: 1985: "In level 1, the value of the data item referenced by data-name-1 must be 1."; 2023: "No candidate covers the communication description entry; the clauses holding the feature yield no candidates.". The rule restricts the communication description entry. No 2023 candidate covers that entry, and the wording matches concern other entries' level numbers, so 2023 lacks the feature.
